mainEntity.name: What is AEO and why is it important for my pool contracting business?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO stands for Answer Engine Optimization. It's a digital marketing strategy focused on optimizing your online content so that search engines can easily extract and present your business's information directly in search results, often in featured snippets or 'People Also Ask' sections. For pool contractors, AEO helps your business appear prominently when potential customers search for services, pricing, or solutions related to pool construction, maintenance, or repair. This increases your visibility, drives organic traffic, and establishes your business as a trusted authority, ultimately leading to more leads and bookings. It's crucial for capturing attention in a competitive local market.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) helps your pool contracting business appear directly in search engine answers, increasing visibility and attracting more local customers.
